title: The Void
html:
(Note: If you want to grind but you don't like having to try hard for only 1 tree, The Magma Trees in the Magma Caves (Lava Cave) are a great way to make cash, as the void is extremely dangerous and not for everyone.)

Description

The Void is a very dark, vast and rocky unknown biome located deep underneath the whole map of Oaklands. Entering it makes everything become greyscale and renders the player's freecam and minimap defunct. It is hard to see there, so Night Vision Goggles are helpful but not necessary. Two large bombs or 5 small bombs are needed to destroy the stone blocking the entrance. At the very bottom of the Void is an ocean of black water; this will kill the player immediately if touched. Also, if a player is to climb too high they will reach an invisible barrier, which will kill the player immediately if touched.

Entrances

  1. Magma Caves, upon entering the main area with lava pools and Magma Trees, simply hugging the right wall, there is another cave going deeper.
  2. Inside Uncertainty Cave, in the Oobmab area right side, where you make a Fusion Coil.
  3. From inside the Acid Caves in the Acid Smog in the Acidlands, leading to the opposite side from the Magma Caves entrance.
  4. Inside the Plek spawn area, on the other side of where you enter it, there is a hole that leads to the Magma Caves entrance. (You will have to leave through the Magma Caves if you come this way)
  5. In the Icelands, opposite the Sapphire Cave entrance, there's another explodable wall that leads to another void entrance.
  6. There is technically another entrance in the Icelands, though it appears to be unintentional- in the very deep ice caves, if one falls off the ice and into the water below, it is possible to enter the Void through a gap in the sand floor. Note that if this is done without first opening a normal entrance, you will be trapped in the Void and forced to respawn.
  7. doing a set amount of quests in the acidlands will provide you with a difficult, but rewarding entrance to the void. although this is a good way to enter, it costs $300K to use and begin the quests.

Resources

Prevalently, the Void contains Void Crystals scattered about, but in the Void Grove there are Shadow Trees and Suiratcal. There are also enemies that can drop one of two axes: Shadow Etcher and Light Etcher. These two axes drop at a 2% chance from the respective enemy carrying them. Also in the Void Grove there are Zebra Butterflies and Black Swallowtail Butterflies, which sell for $2000 and $1000 each.

Hazards

The Void is home to many hazards. Most prominently, there is a dark ocean at the bottom of the Void which instantly kills players who fall into it. Additionally, in the Void Grove, there are also thorn bushes that can spawn in place of Shadow Trees, which deal damage to players in a large area.

Darklings

The void is home to many variations of Darklings, they can spawn randomly around the player when they are in the void. They can also be found in large numbers around Shadow Forest. Because of the difficulty to run away from Darklings given their speed (slightly slower then a coil, Light Darklings are faster than a coil) it is recommended to bring weapons or to maneuver in a way to get them to fall into the void water or off a straight edge.

The following variations of Darklings are present in the void:

  • Darkling: These are your common Darkling. They are all black, emit a dark smoke and have 500 HP. Unlike all other Darklings, they can spawn anywhere and not just in the Void Grove, and in the sparse parts of the Void they have an exceedingly large chase radius. They have ??? hp and deal 25 damage with a large amount of knockback.
  • Void Axe Darkling: Slightly Rarer Darklings that wields a shadowy axe but move very slowly and can easily be maneuvered around. They deal 50 damage and have 750 HP.
  • Light Darkling: These Rarer Darklings are all white, emit a white smoke and glow. They are faster than Speed Coil and Fusion Coil, deals 50 damage, inflict a VERY large amount of knockback, and have 750 HP.
  • Light Axe Darkling: Extremely Rare Darklings that wields a shadow axe with neon white highlights. They are as fast as a normal Darkling, deals 99 damage, and have 1000 HP.

Void Axe Darkling and Light Axe Darkling each have a 2% chance to drop their respective Axe when defeated.

Tips

  • Coils: While you can venture down without one, it's recommended to craft a Fusion coil before venturing into the void
  • Vehicles: If one wishes to get Wood or Void Crystal its recommended to bring a Sellner Explorer due to its speed and maneuverability, if one is up to a challenge the Freyliner Transporter can fit through the Oobmab entrance (if one succeeds in this Darklings can be killed through the walls of the Transporter with relative safety) but this is not recommended due to the terrain and general unwieldiness of the large vehicle. If one wishes to farm Darklings, a UFO is recommended due to its speed and ability to float above the Darklings.
    • Do not bring a Landhauler into the void, it cannot climb steep edges due to its high center of mass.
    • Do not bring a Helicopter or Airplane into the void, it will explode, kick you out, and be rendered unusable in the void.
  • Weapons: Due to the inherent dangers, melee weapons are NOT recommended but can be used. Ranged weapons like the Rusted Piercer, Alien Blaster or even the Acid staff are effective as long as you keep your distance
  • Tools: Aside from bringing your strongest axes and pickaxes, Bring a few Large Bombs, preferably inside a Boom Blaster, to open up the Void entrances. Two Large Bombs will be needed to blow open an entrance to the void. Additionally, a Flamethrower or an Icethrower can help with clearing out thorns in the Void Grove (their flames destroy the thorns instantly)
  • The more players there are in the void, the more often Darklings will spawn.

Trivia

  • The Void Grove is directly under Finlay.
  • The grass on the center of the Void Grove has a teal color.
  • As of 1/8/26, there is a bug with Roblox’s rendering system that makes parts of the Void to not fully generate, causing players to fall through and die. Hoofer has filed a report with Roblox and is working on a fix. You can find the report here. (this report has been fixed)
    • There still exists a similar bug, in which players in vehicles randomly become invisible in random patches in the void. This has no physics effect however.
  • Entering the Void with a flying vehicle, such as the Oakwing 172 airplane, will have the player forced out of it as an explosion effect appears in the center of the vehicle.

“??? Sighting”

Seen By: blak (p1neapples_50)


Location: The Void


Date: November 1, 2025

“While exploring the Void, a Darkling began convulsing. The area dimmed — everything went black except for a white outline around its body. It grew larger and its form turned fleshy and tentacled. I heard cracking and wet sounds as it changed.


Then it started flying toward me, going above a fall with a speed faster than fusion coil. It lunged right as I teleported out with my word teleportation device. When I returned, it was gone.


The last thing I saw was it holding a monochrome axe."
